title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct final temperature of the inner surface t_1 must be provided.

title: Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up the heat transfer equations for convection and conduction.

title: Temperature Difference
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately calculate the temperature difference between the inner and outer surfaces.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in temperature differences.
